The run failed with a CUDA out of memory error. The system tried to allocate 2.00 GiB but ran out of GPU memory. 

Unfortunately, the error occurred at the system level (memory allocation) rather than during training, so there's no specific epoch or loss value to report - it crashed before it could complete training iterations.

The error message is: **"CUDA out of memory: tried to allocate 2.00 GiB"**

This is a resource constraint issue. The model (TFT - Temporal Fusion Transformer) requires more GPU memory than is currently available to run with the current configuration (40-hour horizon with temperature covariate).
